Resolves #19694

`DockSplitterZoneIdNL`'s AC3 now drags a splitter of the settled dock on every boot. Boots 2 and 3 restore the topology boot 1 saved: the Workspace renders it, then its `cold-hydrate` write re-projects the dock with new splitters. The test took the first splitter from the vdom as soon as `.workstation-dock-host` existed. When that ran before the refresh, it dragged `…-splitter-1`, which the refresh replaces, and the first `drag:start` carried no zone. The diagnosis is on #19694.
- `boot()` finds the page's Workspace and awaits its recorded `refreshPromise` before it selects the splitter. The dock documents that promise as its settled-surface contract, and sibling specs await it the same way. A fresh boot records none and skips the wait.

Evidence: L2 (a hosted A/B, interleaved on one runner) → L3 required for the ten-shard `dev` receipt. Residual: that receipt. Residual-Owner: #19657.

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `boot()`: `findInstances` for the one Workspace, then `refreshPromise && await app.callMethod(id, 'refreshPromise.then')`, before `queryVdom`. |
| AC-2 | [Hosted run 38323201218](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/38323201218), from a temporary branch carrying this head, its workflow and two logged copies of the spec. Eight rounds on one runner, each running a logged copy of the `dev` spec's AC3, this spec, and a logged copy of this spec's AC3. The `dev` copy failed round 8: boot 2 selected `…-splitter-1` while the DOM held splitters 6–8, and its first `drag:start` had no zone. This spec passed 8/8 rounds (16/16 tests). In its logged copy, 3 of the 16 restored boots still held `…-splitter-1` in the vdom when the wait began. After the refresh, each selected `…-splitter-6`, and its first `drag:start` carried `neo-dragzone-6`. |
| AC-3 | The post-merge item below. |

- The A/B above. On every restored boot the dock went from splitters 1–5 to 6–10. Every fresh boot (boot 1) recorded no refresh and kept splitter 1.
